units.function: CLI tests for handing a human/board or Agent prompt into Paperclip by creating assigned Issue Work or adding a comment, then optionally waking the target Agent.
units.dependencyDirection: The Vitest suite writes isolated CLI persona context, invokes prompt command functions directly, stubs fetch and validates identity/persona checks plus selected Issue/comment/wakeup requests.
units.keyDataModels: Versioned CLI profile with board or Agent persona, API key, company/Agent identity, prompt text, optional existing Issue and wake flag; resulting Issue/comment and queued Run.
units.lifecycle: Reject persona/command mismatch; authenticate an Agent key and verify target identity, or resolve target under board scope; create assigned Work or a comment; optionally call Agent wakeup; return actor/mode/Agent/wakeup summary.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 6/6 tests on 2026-08-19 and CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. It covers persona separation, Agent-key target mismatch, board/Agent Work creation and optional comment wake suppression. It omits key audience/expiry, real human identity, duplicate requests, partial create/wakeup failure, retry, risk/approval, data/tool scope, prompt size/content, audit/evidence and concurrent Work state.
units.designRationale: Treat a prompt as durable Issue Work rather than an ephemeral chat invocation, while preventing board and Agent credential profiles from being accidentally interchanged and verifying self-targeting for Agent credentials.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a governed handoff from a real human or upstream Agent into durable Work, with an accountable owner, explicit executor, policy/data scope, idempotent dispatch, approval suspension and complete result/evidence lineage.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT persona separation, authenticated Agent self-binding and durable Work-before-dispatch. Replace the generic board actor with IdentityPort human principal plus delegation/organization authority, make creation-and-dispatch an idempotent application workflow with recoverable states, and bind it to responsibility and data/tool contracts. Do not copy Paperclip prompt command or wakeup endpoint as the canonical API.
units.responsibilityConflict: `actor: board` is not a named accountable human, and assigneeAgentId plus wakeup does not bind requester, responsible owner, permissions/data, risk approval, runtime proof, evidence or result. Agent-authored Work may also require a distinct human sponsor and escalation path.
evidence: 2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 1 file and 6 tests passed
securityFindings: Persona mismatch and Agent self-target mismatch are covered, but bearer audience, expiry, revocation, company membership and real human authorization are not.
Creating Issue then waking Agent is a non-transactional two-request workflow; partial failure, duplicate retry and idempotency behavior are untested.
Prompt text becomes title/description or comment without tested length, content classification, injection handling, data-loss prevention or evidence provenance.
Agent wakeup has no tested expected Work revision, execution capability/version, secret/data binding, risk gate or approval token.
The board persona is a broad authority abstraction and can obscure which human initiated and is accountable for the request.
CLI context persistence is used for persona/company routing, but file permissions, tampering, stale identity and secret separation are outside this unit.
